model_contract.account_balance_basis: Use profit ledger with initial0 for SIM; add50000 only when interoperating with nominal-base diagnostics. Do not mix coordinate systems.
model_contract.net_pnl: Executable fills minus commissions minus separately modeled slippage; include all losing days.
model_contract.cashflow: Trader cash = gross payout request * trader share - external payout/FX/tax. Account debit = gross request, not trader cash.
model_contract.external_costs: Tax, FX, payout fees, extra data/platform charges and infrastructure cost remain UNKNOWN, never silently zero.
model_contract.failed_attempts: Subtract each actual evaluation/reset purchase from cashflow; the examples use one successful attempt only, not expected value.
model_contract.unknowns_do_not_block: Offline development, source-bound cost scenarios, payout-state-machine tests, NinjaScript preparation and replay remain useful.
